light:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: background artwork for the level 2 exam banner, LIGHT theme; landscape 1536 by 1024.
Input images: Image 1 is the old level-2 woven-orbits geometry reference. Image 2 and Image 3 are composition and matte 3D material references for sibling level-1 and level-3 banners.
Primary request: create a new level-2 banner in the same visual family. Preserve the recognizable interlocking curved woven ribbons and nested rounded orbit loops from image 1, but gather them into a single sculptural arrangement exclusively on the RIGHT HALF of the canvas, like the right-side triangle/prism groups in images 2 and 3.
Composition: the leftmost 48 percent of the entire canvas must remain absolutely empty, uniform pale mint #EDF8F6, no objects, curves, shadows, texture, vignettes or gradients there. All visible geometry including its shadows is confined to x=48% through 100%, occupying no more than 52% of image width. Artwork must remain present across the central horizontal strip for a shallow panoramic banner crop. No hard dividing line: pale mint base seamlessly continues behind the sculpture. Close-up restrained matte 3D relief with softly rounded bevels and gentle studio light, similar depth/polish to references 2 and 3.
Palette: pale mint background #EDF8F6, light mint/teal ribbons #D6EFEB, muted teal shading. Tone-on-tone. No gold, yellow, purple, blue, neon or other accent colors.
Constraints: no text, UI, border, frame, symbols, glow, halos, circles behind the sculpture, watermark. No repeating pattern across the whole image. Do not place anything in the left 48 percent.
dark:

Constraints: geometry must remain ONLY on the right, occupying no more than 55% of full image width including shadows. Do not enlarge or move it. No text, UI, border, watermark, gold, yellow, lilac, purple, halos or circular backing plates. The central panoramic strip must keep clear left-half space for a neutral light gray link.
